headline: Liverpool face long road back to top, Mourinho's Real Madrid win ugly
description: The new European season is here, and with it, the triumphant return of Gab Marcotti's Monday Musings. This week, Liverpool and Man United still look half-baked, and Mourinho gets a vintage kind of win with Real Madrid.

headline: Florian Wirtz 'needs to sort himself out' at Liverpool - Gary Neville
description: Liverpool playmaker Florian Wirtz has been told he "needs to sort himself out" after an underwhelming maiden campaign.

headline: Tim Sherwood blasts Roberto De Zerbi after Spurs loss: 'Buck stops with the manager'
description: Former Tottenham manager Tim Sherwood said the "buck stops" with Roberto De Zerbi and his players after he accused Spurs of lacking "desire and passion" in their defeat against Brentford.

headline: Man United monitor Alejandro Balde at Barcelona - sources
description: Manchester United are monitoring Alejandro Balde's situation at Barcelona ahead of a potential move before the transfer deadline, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man City ready to sign Enzo Fernández for £120M
description: Manchester City are ready to meet Chelsea's £120 million asking price for the transfer of midfielder Enzo Fernández. Transfer Talk has the latest.
